form_name: Catering Inquiry Form - Sweet n' Sassy
form_description: Request authentic Creole soul food catering for your Knoxville event

fields.label: Event Location/Venue
fields.placeholder: Please provide the full address where the event will be held

fields.label: Special Requests or Additional Information
fields.placeholder: Please let us know about any special requests, dietary restrictions, or other information we should know about your event.

fields.content:
What happens next?

We'll review your inquiry and contact you within 24-48 hours to discuss your event details and provide a custom quote.

settings.confirmation_message: Thank you for your catering inquiry! We've received your request and will contact you within 24-48 hours to discuss your event and provide a custom quote for authentic Creole soul food catering.

contact_form_7_version.title: Catering Inquiry
contact_form_7_version.form:
[text* your-name placeholder "First Name Last Name"]
[email* your-email placeholder "your.email@example.com"]
[tel* your-phone placeholder "(555) 123-4567"]
[date* event-date]
[select* event-type "Corporate Event" "Wedding" "Birthday Party" "Anniversary" "Graduation Party" "Holiday Party" "Other"]
[number* guest-count min:10 max:500 placeholder "Number of guests"]
[select* meal-type "Breakfast/Brunch" "Lunch" "Dinner" "Appetizers Only" "Desserts Only" "Full Service (Multiple Courses)"]
[select budget-range "Under $500" "$500 - $1,000" "$1,000 - $2,500" "$2,500 - $5,000" "$5,000+" "Prefer not to say"]
[textarea* event-location placeholder "Full address where event will be held"]
[checkbox dietary-requirements "Vegetarian Options" "Vegan Options" "Gluten-Free Options" "Nut Allergies" "Other Allergies"]
[textarea special-requests placeholder "Special requests or additional information"]
[submit "Submit Catering Inquiry"]
